limitations: Record-based exclusion, not upstream-pretraining or perceptual-near-duplicate certification.
Holdout never used for iteration; limited group count may give wide intervals.

acceptance.baseline: minimum full-validation L1 among A/B/SFT/GRPO in identical runtime, frozen before new tests
acceptance.coverage: no lower than baseline on test; report failure-fallback separately
acceptance.nonoperation: report identical pixels and empty/zero parameters; no increase used as success
acceptance.instruction: predefined explicit-direction subgroup plus blinded human review if available; AI review disclosed
